Container.Name: igab-web
Container.Overview: IGAB (I've Got A Budget) web UI — nginx serving the built frontend and proxying /api to the igab-api container. This is the only container that needs a host port; open it in a browser (works great installed as a PWA on phones). Requires igab-api and a PostgreSQL 16 container on the same custom Docker network. See https://github.com/brentonmallen1/IGAB/blob/main/docs/unraid.md for full setup.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Host port for the IGAB web UI.

Config.Name: API Upstream
Config.Description: host:port where the API container is reachable. The default matches the igab-api template on the igab custom network; only change it if you renamed that container.
